Earths mini moon!!


The 2025 PN7 asteroid spotted on August 2nd 2025 by the "Pan-STARRS" meaning "Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System" in Hawaii was a small asteroid at around 62 feet in diameter. The asteroid is orbiting tens of millions of km away but can be as close as 300,000 km away at the closest point of its orbit and will leave us in around 57 years. Heres a picture of its orbit while it follows earth around the suns orbit



Do we have more?

No! but we do have 8 quasi-moons! but i'll only mention 4 here

  1. Found on March 28 2023, which was also found by the Pan-STARRS telescope and its orbit reaches halfway to mars and halfway to venus!

  2. Found on December 15 2022, "2022 YG" this quasi-moons closest orbit was on the 22 december 2022 at 1Au (which is the distance from the earth to the sun) so it poses no threat

  3. Found on April 27 2016, "469219 kamo'oalewa" which was discovered in 2016 and could be a chunk of the actual moon that broke off millions of years ago

  4. Found on 13 April 2004, "164207 Cardea" which is probably the most dangerous as it makes near earth orbits until 2600 when it will shift to a horseshoe orbit
